components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Sólido e convidativo. Roxo Poético background, white text, 8px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #2B112C; color: #fff; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; padding: 20px 32px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(180, 100, 80, 0.4); animation: ds-pulse-ring 2s ease-out infinite; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B38B3E; outline-offset: 2px; } @keyframes ds-pulse-ring { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(43, 17, 44, 0.4); } 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 30px rgba(43, 17, 44, 0); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(43, 17, 44, 0); } }

components.name: Navbar
components.description: Roxo Poético full-width bar, rounded bottom, uppercase Poppins links.
components.html: SOBREARTIGOSCONTATO
components.css: .ds-navbar { background: #2B112C; border-radius: 0 0 15px 15px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 56px; padding: 26.5px 12px; height: 100px; } .ds-nav-link { color: #fff; font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.125em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 23px; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B38B3E; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Article Card
components.description: White card with diffuse shadow, 8px radius, image header.
components.html:
Título do Artigo

Descrição breve do conteúdo do artigo acadêmico.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0px 18px 58px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 20px 68px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.09); } .ds-card-img { height: 192px; background: #C8C1C8; } .ds-card-body { padding: 24px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; color: #363940; margin: 0 0 12px 0; } .ds-card-text { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 24px; color: #8B8C8C; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: White input with 10px radius, Latão focus ring on Roxo Poético bg.
components.css: .ds-input-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-input-label { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #fff; color: #151617; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #d1d1d1; border-radius: 10px; outline: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #B38B3E; border-color: transparent; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8B8C8C; }

narrative.overview: The Deep Mirror. A design system that feels less like a website and more like walking into a well-appointed psychoanalysis office — serious without being cold, intellectual without being pretentious. The dark purple anchor (#2B112C) creates an atmosphere of depth and introspection; the gold accent (#B38B3E) adds refinement without flash. Every component is táctil e convidativo — buttons that beg to be clicked, forms that feel safe to fill out, cards that invite reading. This system explicitly rejects the generic psychology-site look: no pastel blues, no stock photos of smiling people, no clip-art brains. It also rejects cold medical sterility on one side and juvenile trendiness on the other.
keyCharacteristics: Dark purple + gold as committed color strategy (one saturated color carries ~40% of surfaces)
Playfair Display for reflective, literary headings; Plus Jakarta Sans for warm clarity in body text
Generous whitespace and breathing room — therapy starts with space to think
Tactile, weighty interaction (pulse-ring CTA, rounded corners, soft shadows)
Mobile-first, single-column at narrow widths, asymmetric at desktop

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Roxo Poético is the single voice. Latão is the counterpoint, never the melody. A detail that appears in gold more than 10% of the time loses its function.

rules.name: The Warmth-From-Depth Rule
rules.body: The palette does not use warm pastels, beige, cream, or sand. Warmth comes from the purple's natural depth and the gold's glow, not from tinted whites.

rules.name: The Display-Only Rule
rules.body: The hero 90px Display size (Playfair Display 700) may only be used for the primary hero heading. No other heading uses it.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a structural indicator — cards, the hero caption, and hover states.

dos: Do use Roxo Poético (#2B112C) as the dominant surface color for navigation, footer, and the quote band.
Do use Latão (#B38B3E) sparingly and deliberately — focus rings, hover accents, detail highlights only.
Do keep body text at Grafite (#4F4F4F) or darker. Never use Chumbo Claro (#8B8C8C) for body copy.
Do use Playfair Display for all headings — it carries the literary-intellectual tone.
Do use generous whitespace between sections (80px min).
Do use text-wrap: balance on all h1–h3 headings and text-wrap: pretty on body prose.
donts: Don't use pastel blues, light blue gradients, or any medical color palette.
Don't use stock photos of smiling people or generic therapy imagery.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient).
Don't use tiny uppercase tracked labels above every section heading as a repeating scaffolding pattern.
Don't use large rounded-corner icons above every heading.
Don't make the design too informal or juvenile.
Don't use numbered section markers (01 / 02 / 03) as default scaffolding.
